meta.prompt: Summarize this morning's run as a card: 5.0 km, with splits per kilometer of 5:30, 5:25, 5:35, 5:20 and 5:10, and 380 calories. Show the distance, the total time and the average pace per km (work them out from the splits), a chart of pace per kilometer, the splits as a small table, and how it compares with my last run, which was 5.0 km in 28:15: say how much faster or slower I was, in minutes and seconds. And a Share button that, once pressed, reads "Shared".
meta.text:
ChatCard "Morning run" "5.0 km" icon:"directions_run" status:"Done" tone:good w:390
  state shared=false
  Grid cols:3 gap:10
    StatTile "Distance" value:"5.0 km"
    StatTile "Total time" value:"27:00"
    StatTile "Avg pace" value:"5:24 /km"
  StatTile "Calories" value:"380 kcal"
  ChartCard "Pace per kilometer" value:"5:24 avg" values:[5.5,5.42,5.58,5.33,5.17] labels:["1","2","3","4","5"] kind:"bars"
  SectionLabel "Splits" "per km"
  TableHeader columns:["Km","Pace"] keys:["km","pace"]
  TableRow cells:["1","5:30"]
  TableRow cells:["2","5:25"]
  TableRow cells:["3","5:35"]
  TableRow cells:["4","5:20"]
  TableRow cells:["5","5:10"]
  SectionLabel "Versus last run" "5.0 km in 28:15"
  Callout "1:15 faster" "You finished in 27:00, against 28:15 last time." tone:good icon:"trending_up"
  if !shared
    ActionButton "Share" tone:primary icon:"share" -> shared=true
  if shared
    ActionButton "Shared" tone:good icon:"check" enabled:=false
